title: Webbed Cloister
shortDescription: An old abbey walk taken over by silk, with one lantern still burning.
longDescription:
This cloister belonged to the abbey that stood before the Collegium. Silk has taken the arches without breaking the stone. A lantern hangs in a web, still lit.
South, the silk thickens. Something small moves there when you stop walking.

fixtures.name: Caught Lantern
fixtures.examineDescription: The lantern still burns a blue Collegium flame. Silk holds it up, neat as a shelf. Nobody is trapped in the web. Whoever hung this light meant to come back, and they have not.
